For advice about your order, call 0330 128 9838 . Which fuels do you supply? We supply domestic heating oil and kerosene, white diesel (DERV), red diesel for eligible uses, HVO renewable diesel, industrial heating oil, C1 paraffin and marine gas oil. We also supply AdBlue and lubricants. Explore the fuel range above, or contact our team if you need help identifying the right product for your equipment or heating system. How do I get a delivered fuel price? Request a quote with your fuel type, required quantity and delivery postcode. Let us know when you need delivery and whether there are any access restrictions. For domestic heating oil, you can check your price and order online . For other fuels or larger requirements, request a quotation or call our sales team. What is the minimum order quantity? Online domestic heating oil orders start at 500 litres. Minimum quantities for other products depend on the fuel, packaging and delivery location. Tell us the product and quantity you need, and our team will confirm the available supply options. How quickly can you deliver? Delivery times depend on your postcode, fuel type, quantity and the delivery option selected. Available options for online heating oil orders are shown during the ordering process. If you need fuel urgently, call 0330 128 9838 to check the earliest available delivery. Emergency fuel delivery is subject to location, stock and vehicle availability. Can you deliver where access is restricted? We offer different delivery vehicle options, including smaller tankers and 4×4 delivery where available. The appropriate vehicle depends on your property, location and order. Please tell us about narrow lanes, tight entrances, limited turning space or other access restrictions before ordering. Our team can check suitability and confirm any additional charges. Can I arrange regular fuel deliveries? Speak to our team about scheduled supply for your farm or business.
